title: Fixed Open Neck Gourd and Diamond Bead Net
description: One newly authored complete static bead-net gourd rattle appearance. A single thick hollow bottle-gourd body has a finite flat belly foot, rounded broad chamber, narrowing shoulder and long genuinely open neck. Twenty-four complete curved diagonal cords form an attached diamond net around the belly between two whole retaining collars; seventy-two complete faceted beads sit at the cord crossings. The cords follow the original body surface and remain rooted in the collars; beads and cords have small intentional fixed intersections. This whole open-neck chamber and two-direction beaded net is neither the old sealed grooved guiro nor the cylindrical core and independent parallel beaded loops of the cabasa. All numeric geometry newly authored, one model zero scenes and four opaque PBR roles. Beads are subordinate parts, not separate models. Metres, native Z up and horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. Static artistic illustration only; no moving net, cord tension, bead articulation, sound, playability, cultural or historical reconstruction, manufacturing, handling or toy-safety capability. No rig, animation or interaction.
